summary: A set of LiveView HEEx components that render the v2 schema field types (composite, arrayOf, codelist, localizedText, tree codelist) in Studio's document editor, with schema-driven conditional visibility evaluated at render time.

intentions.title: Render schema-v2 field types faithfully in Studio
intentions.evidence: composite_field.ex, array_field.ex, codelist_field.ex, localized_text_field.ex each map a v2 field type to a LiveView component; all reference masterplan-20260425-085425 Phase 0

intentions.title: Schema-driven conditional field visibility
intentions.evidence: visibility.ex evaluates `visibleWhen` predicates (eq, neq, in, empty, non_empty, starts_with) against live doc state; composite_field.ex and array_field.ex gate sub-field rendering through Visibility.visible?/2

intentions.title: Plugin-supplied codelist registry with graceful degradation
intentions.evidence: codelist_field.ex renders a disabled placeholder with the literal `no codelist registered` message when no plugin has registered the list, and routes to tree vs flat vs datalist rendering based on entry count and hierarchy

intentions.title: Recursive nesting of heterogeneous field types
intentions.evidence: composite_field.ex dispatches to ArrayField, CodelistField, LocalizedTextField recursively; array_field.ex does the same for its element type; dotted path prefix threads through all levels

intentions.title: Readonly/audit mode propagated recursively
intentions.evidence: All components accept a `:readonly` assign that disables inputs and suppresses add/remove/reorder controls, passing the flag down into nested composite and array children

intentions.title: Server-side array reordering without client JS
intentions.evidence: array_field.ex uses phx-click with phx-value-action (move_up/move_down/add_row/remove_row) and explicitly defers drag-and-drop to v2, keeping all order mutations as server round-trips

intentions.title: i18n-aware editing with fallback-chain warnings
intentions.evidence: localized_text_field.ex renders one input per language, shows an inline warning when the primary translation is missing but a fallback fills it, and encodes severity for a future DSL
